summary: Almonty Industries Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a press release titled 'Almonty to Host Investor Day via Live Webcast on Monday, October 19, 2026.' The filing is a routine investor relations announcement; management will provide a tungsten market overview and mine-by-mine operational updates. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or capital return—is disclosed. Almonty is a producing tungsten concentrate miner with its flagging Sangdong mine in South Korea. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated.
